description: In production a reload of a partial that is not on the page still sends a diagnostic hook event, although the console warning is removed

browserSteps.value: Listen for diagnostics through the same runtime instance the page uses
import('/_piko/dist/ppframework.core.es.js').then(runtime => { window.__diagnostics = []; runtime.piko.hooks.on('diagnostic', payload => { window.__diagnostics.push(payload); }); return true; })
Reload a missing partial twice; the call resolves and the event fires once

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const events = window.__diagnostics; if (events.length !== 1) { reject(new Error('expected one diagnostic event, got ' + events.length)); return; } const event = events[0]; if (event.kind !== 'partial-not-found' || event.name !== 'no-such-partial' || event.source !== 'piko.partials.reload' || event.context !== '/main' || typeof event.timestamp !== 'number') { reject(new Error('unexpected diagnostic payload: ' + JSON.stringify(event))); return; } resolve(true); })
